data.narrative:
Figure AI, an AI & Software company at Series C led by Brett Adcock, has raised over $1.0B to date and carries a reported valuation of $39B. This valuation appears misreported in public sources; the implied $39B figure exceeds the company's total raised by nearly 40x, which is inconsistent with typical dilution patterns and capital deployment at this stage. Stage-progression methodology is therefore inapplicable due to this data integrity issue.

Peer-median analysis anchors on three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Skild AI ($14.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B). The median valuation across this cohort is $10.0B, with a range of $8.3B to $14.0B. The broader comparable universe includes eight private companies in AI & Software alongside one public reference point (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8.5B to $11.5B, centered on a $10.0B median. Key uncertainties include the absence of validated post-money data from Figure AI's most recent round, limited depth in the peer set for robotics-focused AI companies specifically, and the nascent stage of commercial revenue recognition across the comparable group. A single-method triangulation carries inherent limitation; additional transaction data or revenue visibility would strengthen conviction in this range.
